create_spaced_diffusion: create a SpacedDiffusion process that skips steps in a base diffusion using selected timesteps
compute_space_timesteps: compute a set of strided timesteps from an original diffusion process given section counts
use_ddim_timesteps: use space_timesteps with a ddimN string to get DDIM-style fixed striding for N steps
run_training_losses: run training_losses on a SpacedDiffusion model with wrapped timestep mapping for sparse data
compute_p_mean_variance: compute the posterior mean and variance for a model using SpacedDiffusion with wrapped timesteps
